vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a known vulnerability does not wait for the nightly window. Once Renovate runs, GitHub's 'Dependabot security updates' setting is switched off so one tool raises the pull request rather than two; the alerts themselves stay on — they are what this reads.

packageRules.description: Patch, pin and digest updates merge themselves once the required checks pass (main is protected). Everything else waits for a person: this software holds whistleblower reports, and a bad dependency is a breach, not an outage.
Security-relevant libraries never merge themselves, whatever the update type: crypto, JWT, password hashing, TOTP, the web framework and the attachment parsers that see untrusted files.
uv is pinned in the Dockerfile (COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv) and in every workflow. They move in ONE pull request; tests/test_build_pins.py fails if they disagree.
Python is written in the Dockerfile, every workflow's setup-python and pyproject's requires-python. One pull request, never auto-merged — a runtime bump is a release decision.

PostgreSQL and Redis images appear in both compose files, the Ansible template and three workflows. Each moves as one pull request. A PostgreSQL major needs a dump and restore (docs/docs.html upgrade section), so majors are never auto-merged.
GitHub Actions, pinned to commit digests.

customManagers.description: uv installed with pip in the workflows. The Dockerfile copy is found by the dockerfile manager; tests/test_build_pins.py keeps both equal.
Images in files no built-in manager reads: the compose files written inline inside workflow run: steps, and the Ansible compose template.

The Python version in setup-python steps and pyproject's requires-python floor. Two components, so docker versioning: under npm versioning a truncated version yields an empty candidate set and the pin is silently left behind (easywall found this the hard way).
The axe-core build the accessibility tests inject. A floating version would change what 'accessible' means between two CI runs.
